worldcombat.skill.beatup.summary: Call in every ally on the field: each one raises a dark shade that rushes the target in turn. More allies means more blows, and each ally's own Attack sets how heavy their blow is.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.use.0: Pile on with nearby allies for a string of dark hits
worldcombat.skill.beatup.use.1: Finish a low target while surrounded by partners
worldcombat.skill.beatup.use.2: Use numbers to chip a single bulky target
worldcombat.skill.beatup.description.0: Each shade deals about %1$s physical damage (the leader's blow); every ally scales its own blow by its Attack relative to the leader, from 0.45x up to 1.8x.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.description.1: Calls living, visible friendly allies within %1$s blocks to pile in, up to %2$s members in total (including yourself), one blow every %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.description.2: Command wind-up %1$s s; each ally launches a straight shade from its own position toward the locked point at %2$s blocks per tick, and the blow only settles on the first non-allied body it touches - walls block it and a target that moves away is missed.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.widen.on: Swarm style: rally radius ×1.3, each blow ×0.82 — more allies join, each lighter.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.widen.off: Elite style: rally radius ×0.7, each blow ×1.2 — only close strong allies join, fewer but heavier blows.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.growth.0: From level %1$s each blow rises to %2$s and the cap grows to %3$s allies.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.growth.1: From level %1$s each blow rises to %2$s and the cap grows to %3$s allies.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.preference.wide: On (swarm): rally radius ×1.3, each blow ×0.82 — more allies join, each lighter, more total hits. Off (elite): rally radius ×0.7, each blow ×1.2 — only close strong allies join, fewer but heavier blows.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance it closes in first; raising it starts the pack from further, lowering it only dogpiles at point-blank.
Requires at least this many members (including itself) within the rally radius before it starts; higher is pickier, lower lets it go alone. A very low target overrides this.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.preference.ai.f: On: low targets rank higher and it may break the pack minimum to finish them alone; off: only pack size and the normal order matter.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.preference.ai.l: When on, it calls the pack even under a hold order; off keeps it only when convenient in place.
worldcombat.skill.beatup.description.flo: Every shade flies at the same locked point (the target's centre or the chosen world point at commit) and can be aimed at empty ground; a target that falls, moves or hides behind a wall makes that blow miss, and an ally that goes down or is removed before its turn is skipped.
